subject: Urgent: Azuro prod spikes — streaming timeouts & retry amplification
messages:
From: Sana Patel <sana.patel@azurohealth.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 12 Jul 2026 08:14:22 -0700
Subject: High 5xx/429 + streaming timeouts hitting prod — need urgent help

Hi Karthik / Marissa / Redwood team,

We are seeing a severe incident in our production environment starting ~07:45 PDT. Our users are experiencing chat streaming timeouts (client-side idle disconnects) and a sharp rise in 5xx/429 responses from the Redwood API. Key notes: 
- Error rate jumped from ~0.2% to ~8% across our chat routes between 07:45–08:05.
- Multiple customer sessions show client-side timeouts during streaming completions; clients then retry aggressively, which we suspect turned into a retry storm.
- We capture short tcpdump snippets and some token-level server logs — attaching samples (log_snippet.txt, pcap_storm.zip).

This is impacting customer SLAs and executives are involved. We need immediate mitigation and a short plan for root cause and remediation. Can you advise on (1) temporary mitigations we can apply on Azuro side, and (2) what Redwood will do right now to stabilize?

Thanks — we are ready to join a call.

Sana Patel
Director, Platform Engineering
Azuro Health
From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Sana Patel <sana.patel@azurohealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 12 Jul 2026 08:22:10 -07:00
Subject: Re: High 5xx/429 + streaming timeouts hitting prod — need urgent help

Sana — thanks for the heads-up and the artifacts. I’m escalating this to our SRE and backline infra team now. Initial asks:
- Can you confirm the client retry policy (backoff, max attempts) and whether clients are using HTTP long-lived streaming or polling?
- Do you have a consistent repro request (conversation id or sample request) we can use to reproduce?

Immediate actions from Redwood: I’m pulling Jonas into a dedicated incident channel and we’ll triage the gateway and streaming proxies. We’ll propose mitigations within 30 minutes and stand by for a call.

Karthik Iyer
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Sana Patel <sana.patel@azurohealth.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 12 Jul 2026 08:31:05 -07:00
Subject: Re: High 5xx/429 + streaming timeouts hitting prod — need urgent help

Sana — really sorry you’re seeing this. Quick mitigations Azuro can apply immediately (low risk):
- Reduce client retry attempts to 1 and increase jittered exponential backoff to >=3s to avoid simultaneous retries.
- Add a short client-side circuit-breaker: fail fast for 10s if >5 failures for a user session.
- If possible, switch streaming clients to a non-streaming fallback (single-response) for a short window for heavy users.

From our side we will:
- Temporarily raise per-customer concurrency quota for Azuro while we stabilize.
- Enable additional streaming proxies in the gateway pool (canary within 10–20 mins).
- Apply connection keepalive tweaks to reduce idle disconnects — Jonas will provide details.

I’ve pasted our incident runbook link here for quick reference: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/azuro-runbook

Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
From: jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Sana Patel <sana.patel@azurohealth.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 12 Jul 2026 08:45:58 -07:00
Subject: Re: High 5xx/429 + streaming timeouts hitting prod — need urgent help

Sana — quick technical summary from initial triage:
- Symptoms match a retry amplification pattern: clients see idle streaming disconnects (client-side timeout), then immediately re-open connections and re-request completion, creating spikes that saturate our gateway worker pools and cause 5xx/429s.
- Evidence: tcpdump shows SYN bursts and many half-open streams; backend logs show KV cache pressure and increased latency on tail tokens.

Temporary actions we will push in the next 15 minutes (canary first):
1) Gateway config: increase max concurrent streams per worker, and enable short-lived admission control (token-bucket) to smooth bursts. Patch: gateway_config_patch.diff (attached).
2) Proxy timeouts: increase upstream_idle_timeout to 45s and enable keepalive heartbeats to reduce client idle disconnects.
3) Rate-limiting policy: add a 5s client-level backoff recommendation header and a soft 429 to signal clients to back off rather than hard-failing.

ETA: canary deploy in 12–18 mins; full rollout 30–45 mins after watch. I’ll monitor metrics (5xx, 429, streaming close codes) and post updates. If you can temporarily reduce retries per Marissa’s suggestion that will significantly lower amplification.

—Jonas
SRE, Redwood Inference
From: Sana Patel <sana.patel@azurohealth.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 12 Jul 2026 09:03:11 -07:00
Subject: Re: High 5xx/429 + streaming timeouts hitting prod — need urgent help

Thanks — that roadmap sounds good. Two asks from our side:
1) Exec ask: our CTO is asking for an ETA to full mitigation and whether Redwood will commit to a customer credit if SLA breach is confirmed. Please confirm next steps and who on your side is owning the executive update.
2) Can you confirm whether the proposed upstream_idle_timeout change will have any side-effects for low-latency customers?

We will reduce client retries and enable the fallback to single-response for 30 minutes.

Sana
From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Sana Patel <sana.patel@azurohealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 12 Jul 2026 12:43:05 -07:00
Subject: Re: High 5xx/429 + streaming timeouts hitting prod — need urgent help

Sana — summary and commitments:
- Immediate: Redwood will canary the gateway config patch (jonas) and enable keepalive in 15 mins. Azuro will reduce client retries and enable single-response fallback as discussed.
- Monitoring: I will own executive comms and coordinate a short incident brief at 1:00 PM PDT (we’ll invite your CTO). Jonas will provide minute-by-minute metric snapshots during the rollout.
- Credits/SLA: We will evaluate SLA impact after the incident window; I’ll escalate to sales leadership for a credit decision and update you in the 1:00 PM briefing.
- Action items (owners): Jonas — canary & metrics (jonas_weber), Marissa — customer comms & runbook link (marissa_cole), Karthik — exec update & follow-up (karthik_iyer).

Ticket references: HubSpot 12345, Incident-2026-07-12-AZ.

I’m scheduling the 1:00 PM PDT bridge now — joining details to follow.

Thanks,
Karthik
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
